note: Each equipment item alone, and each card in the first slotted item that accepts it, on the first sample job that can equip it, with the melee build. 'changes' lists fields that differ from the same player with nothing equipped (or with the base item for cards), as [before, after]. Damage values use rnd_force_min. Damage dealt is a normal attack against each target ID; damage taken is a normal attack from each attacker ID, with the player's perfect dodge turned off. Because rnd_force_min makes every chance succeed, a change in critical rate can flip a result between a normal hit and a critical hit.
